nodes.label: The vent wall convects. Solving Darcy–Boussinesq porous flow (a stream-functi...
nodes.statement: The vent wall convects. Solving Darcy–Boussinesq porous flow (a stream-function Poisson ∇²ψ = −buoyancy·∂T/∂x on the real FiPy mesh) gives a buoyant recirculation cell — the hot alkaline conduit rises, the cold ocean sinks, convective velocities ~5× the background upflow (Peclet ~8) — rather than a prescribed uniform upflow. The recirculation mixes cold ocean inward, settling the outlet ~8 °C cooler (59 → 51 °C) while staying inside the Lost City window; flux conservation is preserved within the solver tolerance (flux residual ~5e-5, within the 1e-3 bound).

nodes.statement: A parameter sweep over the (vent pH × dissolved H₂) plane maps the carbon-fixation landscape, not a single run. In the open-flow reactor, sustained reduced-carbon throughput scales with both the pH gradient and H₂ (6.4 → 24 ×10⁻³ mol-C/s; steady pool 7–28 mM); the Tutolo-2026 gradient collapse roughly halves it on the same axes, and the no-gradient / no-catalyst / no-H₂ controls zero it. The favorable region is broadly productive — the sharp dependence is on a SUSTAINED gradient, not on sitting at one pH/H₂ point.

nodes.statement: Robustness EMERGES only in a bounded corner of (cross-feeding exchange_rate x inter-compartment diversity). At low diversity the compartments are near-identical, so cross-feeding/HGT have nothing to share and robustness stays at the sparse intrinsic floor (~0.17-0.25 regardless of exchange); at low exchange a diverse-but-disconnected set holds a broad repertoire fragilely (each capability in one compartment, ~0.33-0.42); only where diversity >= ~0.4 AND exchange crosses ~0.2 does robustness climb to 0.58-0.83. The transition is a phase boundary, not a monotone response to either knob alone. The companion three-view Decision map over (exchange_rate x parasite_load) at the canonical diversity sharpens this — robustness clears the 0.5 emergence boundary only once exchange crosses ~0.2 AND parasite load stays low (0.667 at the parasite-free operating point), collapsing toward 0 as parasites drain their neighbours.
